name: kaoyan-english-assistant
description: AI-assisted study workspace for the Chinese postgraduate entrance English exam.

scripts.typecheck: node scripts/node-tool.mjs next typegen && node scripts/node-tool.mjs tsc --noEmit
scripts.lint: eslint app components lib types tests --max-warnings 0
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test
scripts.rag:index: node --env-file-if-exists=.env.local scripts/node-tool.mjs vitest run --config vitest.eval.config.ts tests/rag-index.eval.ts
scripts.rag:qdrant:sync: node --env-file-if-exists=.env.local scripts/node-tool.mjs vitest run --config vitest.eval.config.ts tests/rag-qdrant-sync.eval.ts
scripts.rag:qdrant:bench: node --env-file-if-exists=.env.local scripts/node-tool.mjs vitest run --config vitest.eval.config.ts tests/rag-qdrant-bench.eval.ts
scripts.rag:eval: node --env-file-if-exists=.env.local scripts/node-tool.mjs vitest run --config vitest.eval.config.ts tests/rag-retrieval.eval.ts
scripts.rag:eval:answer: node --env-file-if-exists=.env.local scripts/node-tool.mjs vitest run --config vitest.eval.config.ts tests/rag-generation.eval.ts
